title: Fix Live Trading Order Types and Position PnL Display
description: Several core trading features are missing or not functioning correctly in both live crypto and live stocks modules.

issues.issue: No support for advanced order types.
No support for advanced order types.
Current Positions section displays only the amount spent on the position instead of real-time PnL.
issues.expected_behavior: Display current unrealized PnL for each open position based on live market price.
